CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56452  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday,
  September 17, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56453  Recommendation to receive and file the presentation from the Community
  Development Department regarding Belmont Shore public safety options.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56454  Recommendation to receive and file the presentation regarding electronic camera
  trailers in the Belmont Shore area.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56455  Recommendation to receive status updates on CSI Patrol of Long Beach’s work in
  the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for assistance for
  September 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56456  Recommendation to receive status updates on Block by Block of Long Beach’s
  work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for assistance for
  September 2026.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments
unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.
